exposure: Risk factors for ectopic pregnancy (e.g. abdominopelvic surgeries, PID, STDs)
cohort: 80 women diagnosed with ectopic pregnancy out of 3809 deliveries at a tertiary care hospital over a one year period.
finding: The study found a 2.1% incidence of ectopic pregnancy, with the majority being tubal and ruptured; linear salpingectomy was the most common treatment modality, and no mortality or acute renal failure was observed.
